blocks.x: How Cyber & Zero-Trust lands in Agri-Food Processing — the constraints that shape the build, the gated delivery pattern, and the deltas we commit against your baseline.

Food processors live on quality, yield and traceability: intake grading, process yield, food-safety evidence and provenance claims. Vision grading, yield analytics and chain-of-custody convert commodity margin into brand margin.

items: Plant networks flat; food-safety systems targeted.
Quality grading by inspectors; variance and throughput loss.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cloud Security & Posture Management, AI Security & Model Protection, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Intake grading, Process yield analytics, Lot traceability) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Food safety (HACCP/EU 178/FSMA) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Identity as the perimeter: workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane: posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves: prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Agriculture & Food Systems level this capability reads as: subsidy/loan application verification with cross-source analytics (fraud and error capture up). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The rhythm is fixed on purpose: progress becomes visible from week one, not after the first steering meeting. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
